Add missing API routes for user and invitation management

Issues Fixed:
1. Added POST /api/invitations/:id/cancel route
   - Frontend was calling this endpoint but it wasn''t defined
   - Now properly routes to cancelInvitation controller

2. Added DELETE /api/users/:userId route
   - Frontend calls DELETE /api/users/:userId directly
   - Backend only had /api/users/delete/:userId
   - Added generic /:userId route at END to avoid conflicts
   - Maintains backward compatibility with /delete/:userId

Route Ordering:
- Specific routes (e.g., /:userId/avatar, /:userId/sessions/:sessionId) come first
- Generic /:userId route comes LAST to avoid matching specific routes

Impact:
- Cancel invitation now works from frontend
- Delete user now works from frontend
- All invitation management features fully functional

Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Implement role-based access control (RBAC) on frontend

New Features:
1. Created usePermissions hook for permission checking
   - hasPermission() - check single permission
   - hasAnyPermission() - check if user has any of multiple permissions
   - hasAllPermissions() - check if user has all permissions
   - hasRole() - check user role
   - isAdmin, isSuperAdmin - convenience flags

2. Created ProtectedRoute component for route protection
   - Protects routes based on required permissions or roles
   - Redirects unauthorized users to dashboard
   - Shows loading state while checking permissions
   - Supports requireAll mode for strict permission checking

3. Created CanAccess component for UI element visibility
   - Conditionally renders UI elements based on permissions
   - Supports fallback content when access is denied
   - Can check single or multiple permissions/roles

4. Protected sensitive routes:
   - User Management - requires ''user_management'' permission
   - Settings - requires ''organization_settings'' permission
   - Billing - requires ''manage_billing'' or ''organization_settings''
   - Audit Logs - requires ''view_audit_logs'' or ''user_management''
   - Super Admin routes - requires ''super-admin'' role

5. Updated sidebar navigation
   - Menu items hidden/shown based on user permissions
   - Stores, Orders, Inventory, etc. require data_access
   - Billing, Settings require organization_settings
   - User Management requires user_management
   - Admins and super-admins see all menu items

Permission System:
- user_management: Manage users, invitations, roles
- organization_settings: Change organization settings
- data_access: View business data (orders, customers, etc.)
- system_configuration: System-level configuration
- manage_[resource]: Manage specific resources
- view_[resource]: View specific resources

Benefits:
- Enhanced security - users only access what they''re permitted
- Better UX - users only see relevant menu items
- Flexible permission system - easy to add new permissions
- Role hierarchy - admins have all permissions automatically

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
